rundown: Rangers beat Canucks 5-1 at Rogers Arena in Vancouver. Rangers led 5-1 after two periods and never looked back. The 2nd period decided it: Rangers won it 4-0.
6 goals in all. Rangers's last: Glenn Gawdin Goal Deflected, assists: Vladislav Gavrikov (6), Jaroslav Chmelar (1), 2nd period 16:10.
Leading the way — Rangers: Glenn Gawdin 2 goals, 2 pts; J.T. Miller 2 ast. Canucks: Elias Pettersson 1 goal, 1 pts; Brock Boeser 1 ast.
Where Rangers won it: they outshot them 30-28 and scored 1 on the power play to 0.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Rangers closed as 1.5-goal favorites and covered by 2.5; the total closed at 6.5 and they combined for 6, under by 0.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 13, 8:59 PM ET. It had Rangers 64% and Canucks 36%, projecting Rangers 3.3 – Canucks 2.4 (5.7 total, Rangers by 0.8).

Final: Rangers 5 – Canucks 1. Right winner: it had Rangers at 64%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Rangers came in with a 3% below average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (11-8-1, 3 scored and 2.8 allowed a game over 20 games), worth about 77 and 77 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.3, they scored 5 (+1.7 goals, 52% over); projected to allow 2.4, they allowed 1 (−1.4 goals, 59% under).

Canucks came in with a 8% below average attack and a 14% leakier than average defense (3-16-1, 2.8 scored and 4.5 allowed a game over 20 games), worth about 77 and 78 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.4, they scored 1 (−1.4 goals, 59% under); projected to allow 3.3, they allowed 5 (+1.7 goals, 52% over).

The bigger miss was Rangers' scoring (+1.7 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 6 against 5.7 projected (+0.3), about the 54th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Rangers by 4 against Rangers by 0.8 projected, about the 10th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Canucks ×1.01, Rangers ×0.99. It favored Canucks, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
VAN ML (+170) at +170: the algo gave it 36% vs 36% fair (+0 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 36%). NYR ML (-205) at -205: the algo gave it 64% vs 64% fair (0 pts) — won (+0.5u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 64%). VAN +1.5 (-135) at -135: the algo gave it 56% vs 55% fair (+0.8 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. NYR -1.5 (+114) at +114: the algo gave it 44% vs 45% fair (-0.8 pts) — won (+1.1u); same number as the close. OVER 6.5 (-102) at -102: the algo gave it 47% vs 48% fair (-1.3 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 6.5 (-118) at -118: the algo gave it 53% vs 52% fair (+1.3 pts) — won (+0.8u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 78% of bets on Rangers, 64% of the money — Rangers covered; total: 87% of bets on the over, 82% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 96% of bets on Rangers, 93% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Canucks, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.998 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -3.2 goals. It counts toward NHL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 65 graded NHL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.954 and gives home teams -0.1 goals. Team corrections so far: Rangers attack ×1.009, defense ×0.960 (5 games); Canucks attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 3.2 goals), no bet.
